description: What a contact ending, the screen's edges, letting a key go, every thing of a tag, slow motion, a tween's end, quitting and a game of two to four say

examples.intent: Serving on letting go, and a ball lost off the bottom

input.natural_language: A brick breaker paddle that serves the ball when the player lets go of jump; the ball leaves the paddle at a slant from where it hit, and a ball that falls off the bottom costs a life

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="serve" type="game">
  <q:set name="lives" value="3" type="number" />
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:prefab name="Ball" tag="ball" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="8x8" ai="fly" heading="0.3,-1" speed="150">
    <qg:on-collision with="side"><qg:deflect target="me" axis="x" /></qg:on-collision>
    <qg:on-collision with="top"><qg:deflect target="me" axis="y" /></qg:on-collision>
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:scene name="court" width="320" height="240">
    <q:set name="serving" value="true" type="boolean" />
    <qg:zone name="left" tag="side" x="-20" y="0" width="20" height="240" />
    <qg:zone name="right" tag="side" x="320" y="0" width="20" height="240" />
    <qg:zone name="ceiling" tag="top" x="0" y="-20" width="320" height="20" />
    <qg:character id="paddle" controller="ship" axis="horizontal" speed="240" sheet="tiles" frame="0" x="160" y="226" hitbox="48x8">
      <qg:on-collision with="ball">
        <!-- the further from its middle, the more aslant the ball leaves -->
        <qg:deflect target="other" dx="{(other.x - me.x) / 24}" dy="-1" />
      </qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <!-- the serve: as jump is let go -->
    <qg:on-input action="jump" on="release">
      <q:if condition="{serving}">
        <q:set name="serving" value="false" />
        <qg:spawn prefab="Ball" at="paddle" dy="-10" />
      </q:if>
    </qg:on-input>
    <!-- a ball out at the bottom costs a life -->
    <qg:on-screen-exit of="ball" side="bottom">
      <qg:destroy target="other" />
      <q:set name="lives" value="{lives - 1}" />
      <q:set name="serving" value="true" />
    </qg:on-screen-exit>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A bomb, and slow motion on the last brick

input.natural_language: Bricks take two hits (cracked after one); a bomb breaks the bricks near it; the last brick goes in slow motion, the hero flashes and hops, then the next scene

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bomb" type="game">
  <q:set name="score" value="0" type="number" />
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:prefab name="Brick" tag="brick" sheet="tiles" frame="1" hitbox="18x18" health="2">
    <qg:state name="whole" frame="1" initial="true" />
    <qg:state name="cracked" frame="2" />
    <qg:on-damage><qg:become target="me" state="cracked" /></qg:on-damage>
    <qg:on-death><q:set name="score" value="{score + 10}" /></qg:on-death>
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:prefab name="Bomb" tag="bomb" sheet="tiles" frame="3" hitbox="18x18" />
  <qg:scene name="wall" width="270" height="144">
    <q:set name="done" value="false" type="boolean" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Brick" x="81" y="45" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Bomb" name="bomb" x="99" y="45" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Brick" x="117" y="45" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Brick" x="200" y="45" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="tiles" frame="0" x="99" y="120" hitbox="14x14">
      <qg:on-collision with="bomb"><qg:damage target="other" amount="1" /></qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <!-- a bomb breaks the bricks within two tiles of it -->
    <qg:on-death of="bomb">
      <qg:for-each tag="brick" var="near">
        <q:if condition="{distance(near, other) < 36}"><qg:damage target="near" amount="2" /></q:if>
      </qg:for-each>
    </qg:on-death>
    <!-- the last brick: slow motion, a red flash fading to white, then the next scene -->
    <qg:on-death of="brick">
      <q:if condition="{count('brick') == 0 and not done}">
        <q:set name="done" value="true" />
        <qg:time-scale scale="0.25" seconds="1" />
        <qg:tween target="hero" property="tint" from="#ff4040" to="#ffffff" seconds="0.5">
          <qg:on-end>
            <qg:tween target="me" property="y" to="100" seconds="0.25">
              <qg:on-end><qg:goto-scene name="won" /></qg:on-end>
            </qg:tween>
          </qg:on-end>
        </qg:tween>
      </q:if>
    </qg:on-death>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="won" width="270" height="144">
    <qg:hud position="center"><qg:counter bind="score" label="SCORE " /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A title with Play and Quit; Quit only where a game can close (not in a browser), and Escape quits from the game

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="quitter" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:scene name="title" width="256" height="224">
    <qg:menu position="center">
      <qg:button label="Play"><qg:goto-scene name="play" /></qg:button>
      <!-- a desktop build closes; a page in a browser has nothing to quit to -->
      <qg:button label="Quit" if="{can_quit()}"><qg:quit /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="play" width="256" height="224">
    <qg:on-input action="cancel"><qg:quit /></qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A raider seen coming onto the screen

input.natural_language: Raiders drop in from above the screen; each fades in as it comes onto the screen, and the scene counts them

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="warning" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:prefab name="Raider" tag="raider" sheet="tiles" frame="150" hitbox="16x16" ai="fly" heading="down" speed="40">
    <!-- seen coming: it flashes once as it comes onto the screen -->
    <qg:on-screen-enter side="top"><qg:tween target="me" property="alpha" from="0.2" to="1" seconds="0.4" /></qg:on-screen-enter>
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:scene name="sky" width="256" height="224">
    <q:set name="warned" value="0" type="number" />
    <qg:spawner prefab="Raider" every="90" x="random" y="-20" />
    <qg:on-screen-enter of="raider"><q:set name="warned" value="{warned + 1}" /></qg:on-screen-enter>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A two-player networked game that others can watch from the title: Host, Play or Watch at an address; a watcher sees the same game and says WATCHING

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="watched" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:multiplayer players="2" start="court" />
  <qg:scene name="title" width="320" height="240">
    <q:set name="address" value="127.0.0.1:7777" />
    <qg:menu position="center">
      <qg:button label="Host" if="{net_status() == 'offline'}"><qg:host port="7777" /></qg:button>
      <qg:field bind="address" label="Address" />
      <qg:button label="Play" if="{net_status() == 'offline'}"><qg:join address="{address}" /></qg:button>
      <!-- no seat: the players' game, from its start or caught up on, the keys doing nothing -->
      <qg:button label="Watch" if="{net_status() == 'offline'}"><qg:watch address="{address}" /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="court" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:character id="left" controller="ship" player="1" axis="vertical" sheet="tiles" frame="0" x="20" y="120" hitbox="8x32" />
    <qg:character id="right" controller="ship" player="2" axis="vertical" sheet="tiles" frame="0" x="300" y="120" hitbox="8x32" />
    <qg:hud position="top-center"><qg:text value="{'WATCHING' if net_status() == 'watching' else ''}" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
